ledger.note: 1599: the Treaty of Stadtilm divides the Schwarzburg lands; Schwarzburg-Sondershausen is born. 'Der Stadtilmer Vertrag (21 November)' divided the lands into Schwarzburg-Sondershausen and Schwarzburg-Rudolstadt; English page 'Partitioned from Schwarzburg in 1599'. The Oberherrschaft round Arnstadt and Unterherrschaft round Sondershausen are the two lordships; the region is my radii.

1697: Schwarzburg-Sondershausen becomes a principality. 'Schwarzburg-Sondershausen was a county (earldom) until 1697'; the German page: 'Christian Wilhelm and Anton Günther II' were elevated to Reichsfürsten in 1697. Same state, same colour.

ledger.note: November 1918: the principality ends with the fall of the German monarchies. The page gives Günther Victor's reign as '28 March 1909 - November 1918' (infobox 'German Revolution: 1918', 'lasted until the fall of the German monarchies in 1918') and no day; 'it became the Free State of Schwarzburg-Sondershausen'. Infobox status 'State of the German Empire' (no dates on the page). Federal state of the German Empire from 1871 ('The other states retained their own governments but had only limited aspects of sovereignty', German Empire page). Was a dissolve in 1871 into german-empire; moved to November 1918 and the counterpart changed to weimar-republic on the 3 Nov 2026 fix (fx-53 D01, as fx-46 R122 did for Bavaria): the Empire was this state's overlord, not its successor.

wars.name: Austro-Prussian War
wars.outcome: The principality 'voted against Austria's mobilization proposal' and, in 1866-1867, joined the North German Confederation; military sovereignty passed to Prussia. No territory changed hands.

certainty.note: Two detached lordships, 60 km apart; the pages name districts, not boundaries.

The lordships are named by districts (Verwaltungsbezirke of 1850); no survey line is described on the pages opened. The Cliopatria shape is a coarse hull. 1872-1918 (fx-53): the dossier records no frontier change after 1871; the state keeps its 1870 outline as a federal state of the German Empire.

notes:
Written for batch eu-20-l (3 pages; budget up to 5). The Cliopatria Name is spelled 'Sonderhausen' but the state is Schwarzburg-Sondershausen; the Cliopatria Wikipedia field is 'House of Schwarzburg' (kept in identity.wikipedia), the proper articles are 'Schwarzburg-Sondershausen' (English and German).

SHAPES. Four shapes (1820-1863, 1864-1865, 1866-1869, 1870): 1,210 / 1,189 / 1,079 / 1,079 km2 against 862 km2 (ratio 1.25-1.40). At the grid they are 5, 6, 4, 4 cells, holding Sondershausen and Plaue but not Arnstadt, Gehren, Ebeleben, Greußen, Keula or Clingen. All four are 'adjust' to two radii (Unterherrschaft round 10.88E 51.31N, 13.5 km; Oberherrschaft round 10.94E 50.745N, 10 km, about 887 km2 together), which are mine; the pages name only the districts. The 1866 loss of two cells goes to the Cliopatria German Confederation row (an artefact).

NOT SETTLED. (1) No page opened describes any territorial change of the principality between 1815 and 1871 (the English page is silent, the German page lists only the district reorganisations of 1850 and 1858, the House of Schwarzburg page nothing); so there are no gain/loss events. A gap-filler should look for a source on the Congress of Vienna settlement and later exchanges. (2) 1599-1819 is a single keyframe. (3) The Confederation of the Rhine membership 1807-1813 (German page) and the German Confederation from 1815 are associations, not territory. (4) End year 1871 follows the sibling dossiers; the monarchy ended on 25 November 1918 (German page) and the Free State joined Thuringia in 1920. (5) The English page's 'Merged into Thuringia: 1920' and the House of Schwarzburg page's 'In 1909 Sondershausen was annexed to Rudolstadt' (a personal union under Günther Victor of Schwarzburg-Rudolstadt, 1909-1918; the German page says 'in personal union').

GAZETTEER NAMES WANTED (coordinates used): Sondershausen 10.87E 51.37N, Arnstadt 10.95E 50.84N, Gehren 10.93E 50.65N, Ebeleben 10.84E 51.28N.

COUNTERPARTS NEEDING DOSSIER: county-of-schwarzburg (to 1599, the undivided county) and schwarzburg-rudolstadt (the other half of the 1599 partition, 1599-1920; no Cliopatria row; its land lies inside the Meiningen hull). REALM OF MEMBER STATES (fx-53 D01, 3 Nov 2026): this state now lives to November 1918 as a federal state of the German Empire, which 'retained their own governments' (German Empire page: 'The other states retained their own governments but had only limited aspects of sovereignty'; 'the Kaiser and all German ruling kings, dukes, and princes abdicated' in November 1918) and the German revolution of 1918-1919 page: 'By the end of the month, the dynastic rulers of all the other German states had abdicated without bloodshed'. Changed: identity.end 1871 -> 1918/11; the 1871 dissolve into german-empire became a 1918/11 dissolve into weimar-republic; successors german-empire -> weimar-republic; last keyframe (principality-of-schwarzburg-sonderhausen_1870) carried to 1918 ('to'); capital and certainty to 1918. The german-empire dossier no longer gains this land in 1871 nor lists the state as a predecessor, and weimar-republic lists it as a predecessor (fx-53 D02, D04). The hierarchy.csv row principality-of-schwarzburg-sonderhausen -> german-empire (constituent, 1871-1918) is for the orchestrator. The page gives 'November 1918' for the end of Günther Victor's reign and no day.
